complex_002.original: Hypertension >160 mmHg requires ACE inhibitors or calcium channel blockers.
complex_002.cstl_redacted:
```
DEFINE Hypertension AS condition [id=e1, value=LIT2QZK]
DEFINE LIT1QZK AS treatment [id=e2]
DEFINE LIT0QZK AS treatment [id=e3]

RELATIONS [
(LIT1QZK) EITHER_OR (LIT0QZK) [id=r1]
]

CONSTRAINTS [
(REQUIRE) Hypertension ADMINISTRER LIT1QZK [id=c1]
(REQUIRE) Hypertension ADMINISTRER LIT0QZK [id=c2]
]
```
complex_002.reconstruction_redacted: Hypertension with value LIT2QZK requires administration of either LIT1QZK or LIT0QZK.
complex_002.reconstruction: Hypertension with value 160 mmHg requires administration of either ACE inhibitors or calcium channel blockers.
